title: Papaflessas
actors: Dimitris Papamichael, Alekos Alexandrakis, Angelos Antonopoulos
plot: Under the Ottomans' reign of terror in early-1820s Greece, Papaflessas played a key role in the nation's uprising to gain its independence, until his heroic fall against the tyrants' brutal multitudes, on May 20, 1825.
